name: koipond
title: koipond
blurb: the bluesky firehose as a calm koi pond. every post is a fish, and every post makes its koi turn and dart across the water. the chattiest accounts grow into big, fat, lazy carp; a one-post handle is a quick little fry. click the water to scatter food. @kumavis.me asked for this one (re-tagged by @caleb.jasik.xyz).
